subject: Ephemeral capacity window for weekend load validation
messages:
From: Sandeep Reddy <sandeep@kairo.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Weekend load window — request for ephemeral capacity

Hi Marcus,

We finally finalized the test harness and are planning a full-throughput soak over the weekend (Dec 11–12) to validate 99th percentile latency under sustained concurrent sessions. Our internal QA will run ~12k concurrent virtual users in phased waves; peak token/sec estimates are attached in the test plan.

Two asks: can Redwood provision an ephemeral credit window (or short-term capacity allocation) that covers the traffic for the weekend? We are still in POC so a one-off promotional credit or short reserved window would help us finish the latency validation and move to pilot.

Timing: kickoff Friday night (Dec 10 22:00 PST) through Sunday 18:00 PST.
Acceptance criteria for the test: sustained throughput at target request mix, stable 99p latency <= 850ms for generation workloads.

Thanks — please loop in whoever owns promo credits.

—Sandeep
QA Lead, Kairo AI

Attachment: poc-test-plan-kairo.xlsx (spreadsheet with load schedule and token/sec estimates)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sandeep Reddy <sandeep@kairo.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 17:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Weekend load window — request for ephemeral capacity

Hi Sandeep — thanks for the clear plan and for attaching the schedule. This is the kind of validation we want to support. A few quick clarifications so I can get an internal credit authorization: 

- Confirm total estimated token count for the full window (rough number is fine).
- Are you using streaming responses for the majority of calls or short generation templates?
- Any nonstandard security requirements for the test (VPC, IP allowlist) or is this fine over our hosted staging region?

Monica — can you advise on a promotional credit allocation for a one-week ephemeral window (weekend plus buffer)? If needed we can split across two levers: account credits for token consumption + a short reserved burst to guarantee capacity.

Sandeep — if you can reply with the token estimate and whether you need region-specific routing I’ll pull the request through.

Best,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Weekend load window — request for ephemeral capacity

Thanks for the details. Reviewed the attached plan. High level: approved under promo-credit guidelines with two controls.

1) Credit allocation: we can issue a one-off promotional credit equivalent to $6k (covers estimated token consumption and buffer). This is conditional on receiving the final estimated token count and a signed short MOU stating the test window and acceptance criteria.
2) Capacity guarantee: engineering can reserve a short burst allocation for the weekend (12/10 22:00 PST -> 12/12 18:00 PST) limited to the levels in the test plan. If usage materially exceeds estimates we will throttle back to avoid noisy-neighbor impact across other POC customers.

I attached the approval stub for records. Please get Sandeep to countersign the MOU so Finance can apply the credit. Aditya — please schedule the capacity reservation with infra and confirm region (us-west-2) and IP allowlist.

Attachment: credit-approval-20261206.pdf (approval memo + MOU stub)

Monica Patel
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Quick manager note — thanks team. A couple of operational guardrails to add before we sign:

- Canary kickoff: run a progressive ramp (10% drift up over 30 minutes) to detect regressions. Do not allow full blast before the canary window is green.
- Latency watchdog: hook the test harness to our alerting topic so we can auto-throttle if 99p > 1.2s for more than 10 minutes.
- Post-run report: capture model-level token distribution and per-instance CPU/GPU utilization for our performance playbook.

If we keep these controls we can approve the promo credit and capacity reserve as Monica suggested. Marcus, please confirm and issue the MOU to Sandeep.

—Evelyn
VP, Customer Success
